elements.description: Drag files in and watch them upload – a form-associated element.

properties.name: accept
properties.description: Allowed types: extensions (".pdf"), MIME types ("application/pdf") or wildcards ("image/*") – any file when unset

properties.name: onUpload
properties.description: Uploads a file; simulated when unset (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for form submission: the added files (not the rejected ones) are submitted under it

properties.name: required
properties.description: A form needs at least one file that isn't rejected

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: No files can be added, retried or removed

properties.name: hint
properties.description: Text under the title – defaults to the accepted types and size

properties.name: autoplay
properties.description: Plays a sample drop on its own – nice for previews

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: files dropped without onUpload are simulated silently

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The list of files changed (added, progressed, finished, failed, removed); detail `{ value: UploadItem[] }`. Cancelable.

props.name: accept

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file in bytes

props.name: onUpload
props.description:
Upload a file and report its progress (0–1); throw to mark it as failed. `signal` aborts when the row is
removed or the dropzone unmounts – stop the upload then. Simulated when left out (and warns once, unless
`demo` is set)

props.name: value
props.description:
The list of files. Controlled when defined – pass back what onChange reports (progress included), preload
files that are already uploaded, or clear it with []. Otherwise the dropzone keeps its own list

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting list when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the list changes

changelog: dropzone reports progress through `onChange` at most once a second (status changes are still reported at once).

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: Form association (ElementInternals)
features.why: The element's value is submitted with its form, and it takes part in form validation and reset.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
